projects.name: NMS Apps — Enterprise HRIS Platform
projects.description: Company-wide HRIS built as a single Laravel + React platform split into three business domains: Human Resources, Attendance & Timekeeping, and Payroll & Finance. Serves the entire organization for employee records, biometric attendance, and Philippine-compliant payroll.
projects.role: Core developer and maintainer, contributing major features across all three domains.

modules.name: Human Resources
features: Employee 201 file management, company directory, departments, sections, ranks, and job-title settings
Organizational chart, employee grouping with tags, and dynamic custom form fields that let HR extend employee records without code changes
Leave credits, special leaves, and monetized leave handling
Offenses, policies, and automated document mailing with configurable templates
Help desk, knowledge base, patch notes, and patient chart modules
Activity and user-log auditing across the platform

modules.name: Attendance & Timekeeping
modules.description: Biometric time capture through validated attendance records.
features: Biometric/RFID time-log ingestion that processes raw device logs into validated attendance records via queued jobs
Roster and schedule management with bulk upload and export
Timesheets, breaksheets, tardiness, and overbreak tracking
Filing and approval flows for overtime, rest-day work, leaves, suspensions, AWOL, and NCNS
Cut-off automation that closes, recomputes, and unlocks attendance periods on schedule
Time-log validator with automated Telegram and email notifiers that flag missing or malformed logs before payroll runs
IP whitelisting and off-premise time-log detection

modules.name: Payroll & Finance
modules.description: Philippine-compliant payroll computation, statutory reporting, loans, and payslips.
features: Payroll computation engine covering gross pay, night differential, overtime, rest-day, and holiday pay, with strict timezone handling for holiday overtime and rest-day boundaries
Statutory Philippine contributions and reporting: SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG/HDMF, and BIR withholding tax with versioned contribution tables
13th-month pay, last-pay/final-pay computation, payroll adjustments, and payroll movement reporting
Full loan module: loan types, settings, amortization schedules, max-loanable rules, signature prerequisites, and a dedicated loan-status page with Telegram notifications
Payslip generation with automated Telegram payslip distribution, payday scheduling, and annual/comparative-year summaries
Government-mandated and internal reports with Excel and PDF export pipelines

responsibilities: Architected shared foundations used by all three domains: role- and permission-based access control, OAuth SSO, queued jobs, Redis caching, and a reusable Excel/PDF report-export layer
Designed scalable database schemas for employee, attendance, and payroll data
Ensured secure handling of sensitive personnel and payroll information
Optimized heavy queries for efficient data retrieval across large attendance and payroll datasets
Integrated AI and workflow automation through assistant modules, an n8n client API, and Telegram-based notification delivery
